systems.system: SIPAO (Système d'information policière pour l'Afrique de l'Ouest)
systems.platform: SIPAO / WAPIS, INTERPOL programme funded by the European Union
systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior of Senegal, under a memorandum of understanding signed with INTERPOL on 19 June 2019
systems.tiers: none stated for Senegal: the memorandum is signed and equipment for signatory countries was due in September 2019

note: For Senegal the newsletter states only the signing of the memorandum of understanding with INTERPOL on 19 June 2019 and its contact point's visit to Niger's installations in June 2019; nothing is in operation in Senegal and nothing is said of stations or brigades entering reports. The site counts it gives (26 sites in Niamey, more than 35 posts in Accra) are other countries'.
